This completed development in Bandar Baru Tampin, Negeri Sembilan, comprises 13 two-storey shop offices. The project record lists the development period as 2015 to 2017. The count refers to the development as a whole. To enquire about a particular shop office, identify the unit or street address so the team can check the correct property.

The project record mentions both Malay Reserve land and state leasehold. Ask for the title particulars for the individual lot you are considering. If you need to confirm tenure or restrictions, use those particulars when requesting the relevant documents. The portfolio entry gives an overview of the development and does not identify which particulars apply to each of the 13 units.

For a viewing or a question about availability, include the project name, the unit you are interested in and your preferred dates in your enquiry. Ask the team to confirm the current asking price and availability for that unit before arranging your visit.
